title: [AB#647643] Retain remote files and safely retire verified local references
summary: External storage now retains remote files instead of deleting them when removing attachments, preventing data loss when attachments are shared between documents. Explicit retirement clears only local metadata after verifying the attachment and its content remain intact.
key_points: Remote files are retained rather than deleted to prevent losing shared attachments
Attachment deletion cannot affect other attachments' shared files
Explicit retirement clears only local external metadata after locking and verification
Stronger test coverage added for quote posting, copy/move operations and retirement flows
quote: The accepted fix retains remote files instead of deleting them.
